title: Fellow Grave Robber
description: A wiry figure freezes mid-crouch beside a pried-open tomb, a bulging sack slung over one shoulder. His eyes dart between your party and the shadowed exit behind him. A crowbar dangles from his belt, and grave dust cakes his clothing from head to toe. He raises one hand slowly — whether in greeting or surrender is unclear.

choices.label: Team up with him
choices.description: Two crews can crack more tombs than one.

outcomes.text: The robber grins and leads you to a crypt he couldn't open alone. Together you force the door and split the haul — a fair deal.
He shares his knowledge of the local crypts and points you toward an untouched burial chamber. The partnership pays off.
He waits until your guard is down, then cracks one of your heroes over the head with his crowbar and bolts with a fistful of your coin.

choices.label: Confront and rob him
choices.description: He has a full sack. You have a full party.

outcomes.text: He drops the sack and runs without a fight. Inside you find coins, bone marrow, and a bundle of wraith thread. Not a bad haul.
He fights back with desperate ferocity, slashing wildly with his crowbar. You overpower him, but not before he draws blood.
The commotion attracts attention. Shambling forms converge on the noise from adjacent corridors. The robber vanishes in the chaos.

choices.label: Nod and move on
choices.description: Live and let loot. Professional courtesy among grave robbers.

outcomes.text: You exchange a nod — the unspoken code of the Necropolis. He goes his way, you go yours. No trouble.
